channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Rochdale Sixth Form College to host Open Evening on 19 November
item.description: Prospective students and families are invited to explore courses and meet staff at Rochdale Sixth Form College's Open Evening.

item.title: Rochdale and Bury see significant increases in driving test pass rates
item.description: Driving test pass rates in Rochdale and Bury have seen notable increases, with Bury recording a six percentage point rise.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Sunday 1 November 2026
item.description: 2 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Rochdale remembers as community gathers for Remembrance Day services
item.description: Members of the public are invited to attend the Remembrance Day services on 8 November 2026, supported by the council.

item.title: Roadworks on Smithy Bridge Road in Littleborough scheduled for 15 November 2026
item.description: Temporary road closures will affect Smithy Bridge Road and surrounding areas during early hours on 15 November 2026.

item.title: Rochdale residents return home after car crash causes gas leak
item.description: Residents evacuated from Halifax Road in Rochdale can now return home after emergency services contained a gas leak following a car crash.

item.title: Middleton schools face financial challenges due to declining pupil numbers
item.description: Middleton schools are grappling with financial pressures as a significant drop in birth rates is expected to impact primary school enrolments in 2027.

item.title: Birthday cards for Wendy: family’s heartfelt appeal ahead of her 79th birthday
item.description: Wendy Bamford turns 79 on Wednesday 4 November, and her birthday wish is simple: cards filled with kind words.

item.title: St Luke’s Church in Deeplish announces upcoming services and community events
item.description: St Luke’s Church in Deeplish will hold a Morning Praise service on November 1, followed by a series of community activities throughout the month.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Saturday 31 October 2026
item.description: 3 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Charlie Tasker thriving during loan spell at Rochdale from Brighton
item.description: Charlie Tasker, on loan from Brighton, is making a strong impact at Rochdale, adapting well to a new position and earning the fans' support.

item.title: Road closures announced for Heywood Christmas Festival on 14 November 2026
item.description: Temporary road closures will affect several streets in Heywood during the Christmas Festival, as announced by Rochdale Borough Council.

item.title: Heywood’s Little Play Town put up for sale as owner reassures families it will stay open
item.description: Owner Jackie is seeking a buyer after four years, with Little Play Town remaining open and existing party bookings going ahead as planned.

item.title: Plans approved for 27 affordable homes in Rochdale town centre
item.description: Great Places Housing Group's proposal for 27 affordable homes on Drake Street has received approval from Rochdale Council, aiming to address local housing needs.

item.title: Rochdale magicians help organise North West Magic Dealers Day
item.description: Two Rochdale-based officers of the Order of the Magi are helping organise a day of magic stalls and shared skills in Manchester on 15 November.

item.title: Rochdale Boroughwide Housing Limited awards VAT services contract to S3TAX Limited
item.description: Rochdale Boroughwide Housing Limited has awarded a contract for VAT services to S3TAX Limited, valued at £14,750, effective from November 1, 2026.

item.title: Port Vale to stream Rochdale match live on October 30
item.description: Port Vale Football Club will face Rochdale in a home match, promising an exciting encounter for fans. Details about the fixture can be found on the official Port Vale website.

item.title: Steven's 15-stone weight loss transformation at Heywood Sports Village
item.description: Steven's remarkable journey to lose 15 stone has transformed his health and confidence, allowing him to enjoy life with his family.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Friday 30 October 2026
item.description: 8 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Middleton designated as mayoral development area to boost regeneration
item.description: Greater Manchester Mayor Bev Craig has designated Middleton as a mayoral development area, aiming to enhance economic development and housing in the town.

item.title: Rochdale Mayfield ARLFC partners with Gymbound for new gym and sponsorship
item.description: Rochdale Mayfield ARLFC has unveiled a partnership with Gymbound, enhancing fitness for players and promoting community health initiatives.

item.title: Patrick Whelan, 62, dies in roadside work incident in Rochdale
item.description: Patrick Whelan, a 62-year-old from Liverpool, has died following an incident at a roadside work site in Rochdale, remembered by family as a hardworking and jolly man.

item.title: Eight winners honoured at Rochdale Diversity Awards 2026
item.description: The Rochdale Diversity Awards celebrated eight winners for their contributions to equality and community cohesion at a ceremony attended by over 350 guests.

item.title: Sir Ian McKellen to headline event at Factory International in Rochdale
item.description: Sir Ian McKellen is set to headline an event at Factory International in Rochdale, as part of a broader initiative to reshape local public spaces into cultural hubs. This event, scheduled for October 31, aims to engage the community in discussions about transforming parks, libraries, and other public areas.

item.title: Former police officer sacked for sharing confidential information with Rochdale drug dealer
item.description: Tubah Hamid, a former Tameside police officer, was dismissed after breaching confidentiality by sharing police information with her Rochdale drug dealer partner.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council publishes community events calendar for 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has released its community events calendar for 2026, detailing various activities aimed at engaging local residents throughout the year.

item.title: Rochdale AFC youth team eliminated from FA Youth Cup by Wigan Athletic
item.description: Rochdale AFC's youth team has been eliminated from the FA Youth Cup following a loss to Wigan Athletic in the first round.

item.title: Police appeal for help finding Kibriya Ahmed linked to missing children
item.description: Kibriya Ahmed, 42, is wanted after his two children were reported missing. He has connections to Rochdale and Manchester.

item.title: Police appeal for help in locating Kibriya Ahmed after his children reported missing
item.description: Kibriya Ahmed is wanted after his two children were reported missing. Police believe he may know their whereabouts.

item.title: Comprehensive news updates available for Rochdale Town Centre
item.description: Residents and visitors can access the latest news about Rochdale Town Centre through the Manchester Evening News, ensuring they stay informed about local developments and events.

item.title: Nine men convicted in Rochdale child sex grooming case
item.description: Nine men have been convicted for their roles in a child sex grooming ring in Rochdale, abusing vulnerable girls between 2008 and 2010.

item.title: Rochdale Council oversees local services for 205,000 residents
item.description: Rochdale Metropolitan Borough Council manages essential services for the community, including waste collection and leisure facilities, from its historic town hall.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Thursday 29 October 2026
item.description: 2 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Rochdale Bonfire Night celebrations set for Bowlee Community Park and Heywood
item.description: Rochdale's Bonfire Night celebrations will feature fireworks displays at three locations, starting at Bowlee Community Park on November 2.

item.title: Spring Bank Lane, roadworks in Rochdale on 12 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Spring Bank Lane in Rochdale; expected timings: 8am–6pm on Thursday, 12 November 2026.

item.title: New transport policing command to cover Rochdale’s buses, trams and roads
item.description: A new Greater Manchester command brings transport and roads policing together, with more than 60 new officers announced across the network. No separate Rochdale allocation has been published.

item.title: Swift & Friends
item.description: ✨ SWIFT & FRIENDS ✨ 🎤 The ULTIMATE Swiftie experience is hitting the road! Get ready for a full‑out pop spectacle featuring the UK’s leading tribute artists, incredible dancers, and a LIVE band bringing the magic to life. Rochdale, Champness Hall, Drake St, Rochdale OL16 1NZ, UK

item.title: Rochdale Diversity Awards celebrate community contributions
item.description: The Rochdale Diversity Awards, held on October 28, 2026, recognised individuals and organisations making a positive impact in the community, with MP Paul Waugh in attendance.

item.title: Lachlan Lanskey joins Rochdale Hornets on one-year deal for 2027 season
item.description: Australia-born Ireland international Lachlan Lanskey has signed with Rochdale Hornets for the upcoming season after leaving Keighley Cougars.

item.title: Scrooge screening with live orchestra comes to Heywood Civic
item.description: The 1951 film starring Alastair Sim will be shown with a live score from the three-piece FB Pocket Orchestra on Saturday 14 November.

item.title: Newhouse Crescent, roadworks in Rochdale from 27 October 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has announced that roadworks on Newhouse Crescent will start on 27 October 2026, affecting local traffic for up to 21 days.

item.title: New industrial units planned at Caldershaw Business Centre in Rochdale
item.description: Nine new industrial units are set to be built at Caldershaw Business Centre, aiming to boost local employment and support entrepreneurs.

item.title: Manchester Piccadilly Gardens bus station remains closed due to water main burst
item.description: A burst water main has forced the closure of Piccadilly Gardens bus station for a second day, affecting bus services in Manchester city centre.

item.title: Construction milestone reached for Sustainable Materials & Manufacturing Centre in Rochdale
item.description: The Sustainable Materials & Manufacturing Centre at Kingsway Business Park has completed its base build, marking a significant step in the development of Rochdale's advanced materials hub.

item.title: Rochdale council deputy leader detained briefly in Pakistan during civic visit
item.description: Councillor Daalat Ali was held for a short time upon arrival in Pakistan as part of a delegation aimed at strengthening ties with Sahiwal.

item.title: Rochdale AFC announces ticket details for FA Cup match against Fleetwood Town
item.description: Rochdale AFC has released ticket information for their upcoming FA Cup match against Fleetwood Town, scheduled for November 5.

item.title: Rochdale’s Deckers Hospitality Group acquires historic drinks wholesaler Tate-Smith
item.description: The Rochdale-based family group has bought the Malton drinks wholesaler, with existing staff staying and Harry Tate-Smith continuing as trading director.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Wednesday 28 October 2026
item.description: 3 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Heywood lollipop man forced to leap out of way as drivers ignore crossing
item.description: A car and a moped have been seized after their drivers failed to stop for a lollipop man in Heywood, forcing him to jump aside for safety.

item.title: Police arrest 17 in operation against crime gang in Rochdale and Heywood
item.description: Seventeen arrests were made during a police operation targeting an organised crime group linked to violence in Heywood earlier this year.
